apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 198 keeps the selected client resolution/FPS through native NVST resume and ANNOUNCE instead of replacing them with a reduced server snapshot. A new device transfer uses that device’s selected profile; an existing retained session preserves its active request. Membership limits still apply and WebRTC behavior is unchanged. Retains expired-session recovery, full-stream status-bar hiding, account discovery, video/HUD preferences, Metal 4, vibration, controllers and Sessions. 244 simulator tests passed, one hardware-only skip. Physical resumed resolution pending. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
